editorial.name: Coda
editorial.descriptionZh: Coda 是文档、表格与应用三合一的协作空间，现在改名成 Superhuman Docs，页头挂着整条更名公告。官网把常见用法归纳成 Writeups、Hubs、Trackers、Applications 四类，并标出 50,000+ 团队。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看工具改名时首页怎么处理新旧品牌并存
editorial.noteZh: 页面最上方一条橙底公告写 Coda is now Superhuman Docs: The best place for teams and AI to work together. 加 Learn More，左上角 logo 也已变成带 Docs 图标的 SUPERHUMAN Docs，但导航仍是 Product、Solutions、Resources、Gallery、Blog、Pricing。首屏大标 Your all-in-one collaborative workspace.，下面接 Fast Company 的引语 It's more powerful than Google Docs and more flexible than Airtable or Notion.。4 ways 50,000+ teams use Coda to supercharge their work days. 一段把用法分成 Writeups、Hubs、Trackers、Applications 四块，每块配站内实例，比如 Zoom's decision doc、Coda's team hub、Figma's product roadmap；随后一段讲 Coda AI 能 Take the busywork out of your work，以及 Packs 用来打通 must-have tools。对比页有 vs Notion、vs Confluence、vs Quip、vs Airtable 四个。

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Coda 自己的工作空间产品，四类用法、Coda AI 与对比页都在讲同一款工具，归产品与公司官网；条目由 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感收进候选池。
